backgroundGroups.prompt:
Generate a BACKGROUND image for App Store marketing.

USE EXACTLY THESE COLORS (mandatory):
- #3E5EC2
- #082B4D
- #CC3165

The background MUST use these exact colors or darker/more saturated versions of them.
Create smooth gradients and large soft shapes using ONLY these colors.

DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:
- Minimalist flat design
- Large soft rounded geometric shapes
- Smooth color transitions between the 3 colors
- Premium, professional, advertising-ready aesthetic

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:
- ANY white, off-white, cream, or light colors
- ANY shadows or drop shadows
- ANY lighting effects or glows
- Colors NOT in the palette above
- Text, icons, UI elements, people, objects, devices

Composition: Asymmetric balanced layout with 2-3 large rounded forms on dark background from palette

White text must be easily readable on the background.
